description: Get daemon documentation for any RPC command. With no command argument, returns a list of all available RPCs grouped by category. With a command name, returns detailed usage including parameters, types, and examples. Use this when an agent needs to understand an RPC that isn't exposed as an MCP tool, or to check exact parameter formats before constructing a complex call.

command.description: RPC command name to get help for (e.g., "sendcurrency", "getidentity"). Omit to list all commands.

name: help
